The bundled DragonBones core is from the official DragonBonesJS repository:
https://github.com/DragonBones/DragonBonesJS
https://github.com/DragonBones/DragonBonesJS/blob/master/Pixi/4.x/out/dragonBones.js

The core section was copied with its MIT license notices intact. The Pixi renderer
section is excluded; animation.js provides this project's Canvas adapter.
